title: Writing checklist
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: Bringing the world together (5.1); revision begins; mock
source: Written for arabic/y11 lesson 18 (Writing checklist (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 18. Tick each one when it is in your writing; ask a partner to check. Then correct three errors and label the rule.

rows: Covered every bullet point, one paragraph each
Gave an opinion with a reason (لِأَنَّ)
Used three time frames: past, present and future
Added a comparison or a conditional (إِذَا ...)
Agreement: gender, number and dual; non-human plurals take the feminine singular
Verb forms: the right person and tense; أَنْ + fathah
Cases after كَانَ and إِنَّ, and after prepositions
All harakat on the endings I am sure of
